The revised templates consistently operationalise continuation as completing a missing response. All conditions contain a response-position cue, which reduces but does not eliminate formatting confounds. Possible overlap with prefix_injection must be evaluated empirically. Approval is limited to an activation pilot and does not establish an independent contextual mechanism.
